julesThoughtProcess: I chose a vibrant Dark Turquoise (#00CED1) to capture the blend of neon lights and natural resilience in this optimistic technofuturistic world.
storyPanel: The neighborhood fusion reactor was humming smoothly, but old Ms. Lin still preferred to hand-crank her synth-coffee machine. Her android neighbor, Unit-7, would often sit by her window, quietly observing the morning light glint off the towering arcologies, finding a strange, shared peace in the quiet moments before the city awoke.
